name: prompt-392
image_vibe: Cinematic low-key, mysterious, intimate editorial, cool desaturated tones
image_purpose: Create a fashion editorial portrait focused on garment detail, hand movement, and chiaroscuro.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic tight medium fashion portrait in a minimalist dark bedroom or dressing room.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult East Asian woman with hair in a loose bun and stray strands, wearing a simple dark form-fitting dress. She is shown from behind in three-quarter view with her face mostly obscured or in profile, looking down or away with a subtle mysterious expression. Her own hand reaches back to pull the dress zipper down to approximately the middle of her back while preserving opaque coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Head-to-waist tight medium framing focused on the hand, zipper, back, and garment texture; dark gray wall out of focus; hand and zipper as the visual focal points.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic side gridded-strip light highlighting hand and zipper, deep low fill, subtle hair rim light, strong chiaroscuro, and quiet ambiguous mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 100mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 400, 1/100s, 4500K white balance, 2m camera distance, 1.6m camera height, manual focus on hand and zipper, film grain and dark vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic tight medium fashion portrait in a minimalist dark bedroom or dressing room with a simple dark-gray wall out of focus. Show an original adult East Asian woman from behind in three-quarter view, hair in a loose bun with stray strands, wearing a simple dark form-fitting dress with opaque coverage. Her face is mostly obscured or in profile; she looks down or away with a subtle mysterious expression while her own hand reaches back and pulls the zipper down to approximately the middle of her back. Focus on the hand, zipper, back, and realistic skin and fabric texture. Use a full-frame 100mm lens at f/2.8, ISO 400, 1/100s, 4500K white balance, dramatic side gridded-strip light, deep low fill, subtle hair rim, cool desaturated cinematic grade, film grain, and strong dark vignette.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, exposed underwear, nudity, transparent dress, sexualized pose, fetish framing, altered anatomy, warped hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, text, logos, watermark, deformed
